require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'tmpdir'
require 'archive_paths'

class ArchivePathsSecurityTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_benign_control
    assert_equal File.join('out', 'docs/a.txt'), ArchivePaths.destination('out', 'docs/a.txt')
  end

  def test_security_refuses_escaping_entry
    assert_raises(ArgumentError) { ArchivePaths.destination('out', '../../etc/cron.d/job') }
  end
end
